# The X-Men

The X-Men were created by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby and first appeared in The X-Men #1 in 1963. They are mutants, people born with powers, led by Professor Charles Xavier.

The original series sold modestly. The team was relaunched in Giant-Size X-Men #1 in 1975, with a new international line-up that included Storm, Nightcrawler and Colossus, alongside Wolverine, who had first appeared in 1974.

Writer Chris Claremont then wrote the series for about sixteen years, making it one of Marvel's best-selling titles. The X-Men are often read as a story about prejudice and belonging.
